project_type: Python stdlib HTTP server + vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend, PV energy simulator
build_system: None - stdlib only, no package manager needed
verification_instructions: 1. Run tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v. 2. Start server: python3 backend/main.py and visit http://localhost:8000. 3. Open viewer.html and verify 3D scene loads with STL model.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - Python 3.9 is pre-installed, no pip dependencies required. Frontend uses CDN links for Three.js.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No pip dependencies for the app (stdlib only). Frontend loads Three.js from CDN (cdn.jsdelivr.net or unpkg.com). All comments/docs must be in Polish.
contribution_requirements: All comments and documentation in Polish. Simple language for beginners. No external Python dependencies (stdlib only). Frontend uses CDN for Three.js.
key_patterns: Backend uses http.server with custom handler class. API pattern: handler functions in backend/api/handlers.py return (status_code, dict). Services in backend/services/. Models (dataclasses) in backend/models/. Frontend is separate HTML pages served from frontend/ directory. Tests use unittest with mock for external APIs.
directory_structure: Root: backend/ (main.py, api/, services/, models/, tests/), frontend/ (index.html, css/, js/), Dom.STL (binary STL of user's house), Energa.zip (electricity bills with tariff docs). Backend serves frontend/ as static files on port 8000.
